reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, leveraging established techniques (DSC, dilatometry) and CALPHAD screening, but the assumption that single-phase HEAs will always yield a single, well-defined melting event is an oversimplification, as many HEAs exhibit complex melting paths or phase transformations.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion (deviation >10% from traditional methods), though practical challenges of multiplexed high-temperature dilatometry and ensuring identical conditions across an array are not addressed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the research question directly by proposing a high-throughput method for multiple properties, and it would be useful for researchers seeking efficient screening, though it lacks quantitative performance predictions beyond a rough accuracy estimate.
